rows.text: returns qword `+0xB8` of `rcx` when `rcx` is non-null and the top three bits of byte `+3` (`>> 5`) equal 1 or 3; otherwise (null `rcx` or any other value) returns the address `02099DC0`

calls `00344390 + 0x1D` and then `00344390 + 0x27`, each with `r9` (results A and B), passes A to `00344390 + 0x30` and B to `00344390 + 0x3A`, passes those two results to `00344390 + 0x4D` and `00344390 + 0x42` respectively, calls `004686D0` with the mapped A in `rcx` and the mapped B in `rdx`, and tail-jumps to `00344390 + 0x77` with the incoming `rcx` and the returned `xmm0` in `xmm1`

returns without work when `cx` is -1 or when dword `+0x284` of row `(movsx cx) * 0x740` plus qword `022C6F28` is 0 (the row pointer is then zeroed by `cmove`); otherwise ORs 0x40 into byte `+0x4B7` of that row and tail-jumps to `00427320(row, 0x1001)`

notes: FABLE w5-3 draft. Calls to callees the page context does not name are cited by call site (`<entry> + 0xNN`).
